title: Samsung's AI glasses take on Meta with December launch
summary: Samsung announces December launch for its new AI glasses to compete directly with Meta
detailed: Samsung Electronics will launch its first AI glasses after announcing a partnership with Google to enter the AI glasses market, challenging Meta's current dominance and potentially spurring new applications...
